title: Lakhpat Rai Orders the Killing of Every Singh

blocks.text: Once the campaign is approved, persecution becomes policy. Lakhpat Rai and the Nawab proclaim that whoever bore the name Singh was to be killed, and they begin the purge by seizing Sikh servants, retainers, and other dependents who could be found within easy reach.

The order is not confined to armed fighters alone. Officials are told first seize and kill the Sikh servants, while houses are searched and panic spreads among both Sikhs and their Hindu associates who know that an accusation or even a name may now be enough to bring death.

Alarmed by the cruelty of the decree, Hindus gathered together in alarm and petitioned Lakhpat Rai. They pleaded that the captives were innocent dependents rather than rebels, but the regime has already chosen collective punishment over justice and refuses to soften its line.
